scope: Versioned native Intel CPU/VM records, full host XSAVE, in-flight completions, current-session-preserving coordinated rollback and common SDK-clock anchor

assumption_register.assumption: The SDK FP buffer follows the host XSAVE layout, including opaque components.
assumption_register.basis: Retained Apple SDK hv.h read/write_fpstate contract; host CPUID leaf 0x0d; Intel SDM Vol.1 Chapter 13.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Complete aligned image capture and architectural projections.
assumption_register.stress_test: 832-byte Rosetta SDK model; standard and compacted states, initial bits, MXCSR independent of SSE in-use, first/last lanes, x87 TOP and opaque components.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The SDK accepts an image whose CPUID layout disagrees with actual guest state, or physical restore loses an opaque component.
assumption_register.status: retained; structural tests available, physical Intel unknown

assumption_register.assumption: The VM boundary excludes owner requests, backend IRQ writers and topology/mapping changes; independent external writers are quiescent.
assumption_register.basis: Existing lifetime RwLock and VMM checkpoint bindings.
assumption_register.dependent_result: One stopped CPU/RAM/device capture and coordinated restore.
assumption_register.stress_test: Foreign boundary, incomplete topology, concurrent owner-thread contract and real file transactions.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A supported writer mutates the graph while a held boundary is active.
assumption_register.status: retained; external raw aliases remain caller responsibility

assumption_register.assumption: One SDK clock sample and a common lazy resume epoch preserve per-CPU TSC offsets under the supported host-clock profile.
assumption_register.basis: SDK hv_tsc_clock/hv_vcpu_set_tsc_relative signatures and Intel modulo-2^64 TSC arithmetic.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Coordinated clock restoration across independently owned CPUs.
assumption_register.stress_test: Zero, wraparound, distinct offsets, delayed second CPU entry and raw imports.; running and not-yet-resumed raw/VM clock rollback; SDK clock setter failure during rollback
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A second CPU resets its epoch independently or guest RDMSR disagrees with the SDK execution offset. A failed restore rebases the original running/pending clock binding or changes a peer resume epoch.
assumption_register.status: revised after observed loss of 1000 SDK ticks during failed raw restore; corrected original binding/epoch now pass three SDK-model cases

assumption_register.assumption: An SDK setter may mutate before reporting failure; rollback must restore all destination state before ordinary entry resumes.
assumption_register.basis: Existing MSR SDK model and fallible native API.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Per-CPU fences, complete coordinated rollback and VM poison after failed rollback.
assumption_register.stress_test: After-mutation register/FP/VMCS/MSR failures and late TLB failure; persistent rollback failure.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Failed publication resumes a prefix, loses RAM/private state or leaves a peer able to enter after irrecoverable rollback.
assumption_register.status: confirmed in portable and SDK-model tests; physical Intel remains unknown

assumption_register.assumption: The current debugger session owns forward VM restore controls; raw CPU imports own their captured controls; rollback restores original destination notifications.
assumption_register.basis: Explicit user selection and GDB client-owned breakpoint/selection state.
assumption_register.stress_test: Current MTF and #BP interception, stale completion discard, original pending stop restoration.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A forward restore switches the active debugger mode, or failed restore discards its original notification.
assumption_register.status: confirmed in portable and SDK-model tests; physical Intel remains unknown

assumption_register.assumption: Producer/schema/profile/public projections and the complete topology/RAM association are admitted before live writes.
assumption_register.basis: Existing checkpoint extension framing and native producer admission.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Portable native files and target admission without serialized host pointers.
assumption_register.stress_test: Truncation, trailing data, missing/duplicate/reordered fields, incompatible CPU profile, foreign producer and incomplete CPU graph.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A forged or mismatched graph reaches an SDK write or silently falls back to public-only restore.
assumption_register.status: confirmed in portable and SDK-model tests; physical Intel remains unknown

assumption_register.assumption: SDK-model and portable test evidence does not establish physical Intel VMX execution.
assumption_register.basis: M4 Max host; Intel binary executes through Rosetta with exported SDK substitutes.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Qualification boundaries and retained pending hardware gates.
assumption_register.stress_test: Linkage inspection and explicit test counts; separate physical Intel runner if available.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A claimed hardware result has no physical Intel guest-instruction execution receipt.
assumption_register.status: confirmed evidence boundary; physical Intel execution unknown

assumption_register.assumption: Selected 64-bit MMIO SDK-model cases supply coherent long-mode paging and SDK/VMCS control-register aliases
assumption_register.basis: Intel IA-32e paging and VM-entry state requirements; production nonmutating inspection walker
assumption_register.stress_test: CR0.PG/PE/NE, CR4.PAE, EFER.LME/LMA, IA-32e entry; real four-level tables with selected 2 MiB code/operand leaves
assumption_register.falsification_probe: An MMIO checkpoint case enters inspection with LMA set and PG clear, or its decoded operand does not translate to the exit physical address
assumption_register.status: revised after rejected inconsistent fixture; coherent paging now qualified by complete debug and no-debug SDK owning suites; physical Intel unknown

assumption_register.assumption: Current enabled XSAVE byte counts in CPUID leaf 0x0d subleaves 0 and 1 are host execution-state inputs, not immutable compatibility capabilities
assumption_register.basis: Intel SDM CPUID.0DH.00H/01H EBX definitions; source maximum layout/offset fields remain strict
assumption_register.dependent_result: Compatible host threads/destinations are not rejected merely because current XCR0/XSS selections differ
assumption_register.stress_test: Both size fields vary; capability and maximum-size fields remain distinguishable; component-2 offset and other leaves remain intact
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Changing only an enabled-size field changes a profile, or normalization erases component geometry/capability bits
assumption_register.status: revised and qualified by both size-field tests, preserved immutable-field tests and full final host/SDK-model owning suites; physical Intel unknown

change_surface.backend: Intel owner, SDK bridge and full state publication
change_surface.CPU_state: Full XSAVE/native fields and explicit native emulator projection; existing public wire layouts unchanged
change_surface.snapshot: Producer kind 7; strict portable CPU/VM graph admission and full physical spans
change_surface.runtime: A distinct rollback hook retains original destination debugger notifications
change_surface.device: MmioRmwOp gains Serde traits; device behavior unchanged

implementation.FP: 64-byte aligned host-sized images; standard/compacted layouts; init-state materialization, exact 80-bit x87 and reconstructed tags, MXCSR, supported vector/PKRU projections and opaque host-component retention
implementation.pending_IO: Port/MMIO load, store, ALU and RMW continuations; valid received replies survive post-reply failures; acknowledged outputs retain terminal failure and cannot redispatch
implementation.clock: One stopped SDK anchor and common lazy resume epoch; modulo-2^64 offsets; raw CPU imports use an independent epoch. Failed publication restores the original offset, pending binding and shared epoch, including elapsed host ticks; public overlays retain the existing local binding.
implementation.debugger: Forward VM restore retains current MTF and #DB/#BP controls and discards stale completion; raw import restores payload; rollback restores original destination notification. No-debug raw imports reject host debug controls before SDK writes; scoped VM restore preserves the disabled destination controls.
implementation.failure: Partial setters fence ordinary entry; coordinated CPU/RAM/shared rollback; failed rollback fences all peers
implementation.profile: All guest CPUID configuration fields and stable host capability/layout fields are admitted; both enabled XSAVE size fields and host APIC ID are normalized. Exact target profile and RAM/MMIO association; no host pointers serialized; optional physical frequency remains unknown where unavailable
implementation.fixed_controls: PAT and IA32_MISC_ENABLE retain their existing fixed intercepted profile; foreign public PAT values are rejected
implementation.complexity: CPU work/storage linear in bounded XSAVE/payload bytes plus fixed register/schema banks. Shared validation uses bounded region walks and O(Q log Q) IRQ uniqueness admission for Q queued sources.

baseline.observed: Separate fresh processes observed absent native private records and rejection of capture while scalar input was pending

SDK_fixture_correction.explanation: The new MMIO case inherited an SDK fixture with EFER.LMA set and CR0.PG clear. Production correctly rejected it. The corrected case supplies coherent four-level paging and matching SDK/VMCS CR aliases; no production access check was weakened.

baseline.iteration_errors: Initial whole-implementation checks exposed one output Result inference error and a missing producer-function delimiter. These failed builds are retained and are not runtime evidence.

validation.counts_note: Standalone XSAVE cases also occur in the full root library run; owner cases repeat across host and Intel invocations. Counts are not unique-scenario totals.
validation.scope: Actual Intel Backend/Vm/VCpu/Vmm executes through Rosetta with SDK storage supplied by the test executable. Complete owning binaries execute unfiltered. Real .rxc files cover 1/2/4 CPU records; this is not native SMP execution. Raw tests inject each SDK setter class; coordinated tests cover last-CPU failure before and after RAM publication and persistent rollback failure.

parallel_Darwin_limitation.status: unknown root cause; not repaired by this group
parallel_Darwin_limitation.observed: An earlier eight-thread full root run failed ordinary_exit_flushes_queued_trace_reply and consecutive_descriptor_frames_keep_each_endpoint. Both passed exact serial reruns; four-thread ptrace subgroup reproduced the first failure. Final root run executes all cases serially.

validation.root_input_reuse: Final changes after the serial ARM root run are limited to the Intel-only profile normalizer, its portable integration tests, the corrected MMIO integration fixture and documentation. The actual ARM root dependency file excludes all five paths. Every portable production/unit-test and Cargo/dependency input retains its v2 bytes. Complete host and Intel SDK suites were rerun afterward.
validation.broader: Workspace all-target check/build/clippy with C API JIT feature; Intel debug/no-debug library compilation; full portable root library runtime

bounded_scope.finding: Unchanged Darwin ptrace/descriptor tests fail under parallel harness execution; exact serial cases pass. Root cause unknown. Final full-root evidence is explicitly serial; parallel reliability remains unresolved.
Physical Intel full FP/XSAVE/VMCS/TSC and SDK failure recovery have not executed. SDK-model success is not hardware qualification.
Remaining native MSR/intercept and exception/MMIO profiles, IRQ/device coherence, bounded native scheduling/SMP/replay, and A32 FP profile controls remain open.

Public register-only set_state remains fallible and fenced after partial writes. Transactional restore requires the complete native records; raw CPU import requires caller-coordinated device consistency.
Native relative-clock admission requires available macOS 11-or-later SDK APIs and the supported host XSAVE profile. Old-host loader lookup is late-bound; old physical hosts were not qualified.
Full VMM tests include all physical backing, including the existing 4 GiB padding. They perform substantial streaming validation. Existing build roots are removed by guarded post-commit cleanup.
